title: The Hollow Throne and the Crown's stones rebuilt in 3D
changes: The Hollow Throne on its dais, the crown-stones round it and the ward-stones you break are now 3D models baked to pixel art.
The venom caps, ice spikes, ember vents and storm stones of the Crown's lands are rebuilt in 3D too, with their drips, glints, embers and crackles still animated.
